text: ITEM 1 | Roughly 20 small, smooth, oval-to-teardrop pieces, tan to light brown with a slightly darker tip, matte surface with faint longitudinal ridges, dry and firm, each about 2.5 to 3 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, unbroken, uncooked-looking with no browning, glaze, or oil sheen, clustered in a loose heap in the center-left of a white square plate about 20 cm across, covering roughly 20 percent of the plate surface | 45
